column1: # Checks that guard a real bug: check name, tab, issue or pull request, tab,
# what broke. A failing check listed here prints a "guards:" line naming it.
# A name with a / is a test file. Every bug fix adds its check here; the name
# is written WITH the fix, so the check fails before the fix and passes after.
# How to add a row: run the fix's re-run on the generated code (or the Studio /
# unit test), put the check name in the first column, the issue or PR number
# in the second, and one line on what broke in the third.
